title: Campus Fire Alarm
blurb: Anyone who has lived in halls knows this one at three in the morning, standing outside in a dressing gown while somebody's toast takes the blame. The clip is a standard institutional alarm: piercing, repetitive, engineered so that no sleeping human can ignore it. As a prank button it is deeply unkind and extremely effective, particularly over a call to a flatmate with an exam tomorrow. Video editors use it differently, dropping it in at the exact instant something on screen goes catastrophically wrong. Keep the volume sensible before you press it.
origin: A generic institutional fire-alarm recording of the type used in schools and university buildings.
